svg.text: Flywheel next — boundaries: dispatch writes records, curation writes moves, only the operator opens an intent, and the engine runs no agent
source event → capture → signals → one move → intent → elaboration → claims → verdicts → planning → bolt → landing → operation → back to the sources · what crosses each line is written on it

dispatch writes captures and signals and never state · curation writes moves and proposes, never opens · only the operator opens or closes an intent · the engine charges sessions and applies the response, and runs no agent
